cardOverview.overviewText: A Pioneer Heritage card crafted for legacy banking customers, offering exclusive lifestyle rewards, milestone bonuses, and heritage-linked privileges.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: B1G1 offer on movie tickets via BookMyShow, up to 3 complimentary tickets monthly with a maximum cap of ₹700 per ticket.|Upgrading to the Pioneer Heritage Metal credit card offers 4 complimentary tickets every quarter, capped at ₹1,000 per ticket. Additionally, receive up to 20% off on non-movie bookings, with a maximum discount of ₹350 for every 2 tickets purchased.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: CLUB ITC
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy exclusive dining privileges with the Club CLUB ITC Culinary Program, including up to 25% green points on dining at CLUB ITC Hotels & Welcomhotels, up to 5% on non-dining spending, and up to 20% savings at Fortune Hotels; also get up to ₹3,000 off annually with the Pioneer Heritage program at partner restaurants via Indus Moments.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the CLUB ITC app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy a 1+1 complimentary buffet at participating ITC hotels. Complete the payment using your IndusInd Pioneer Heritage credit card to unlock the offer.
